answer: One physical device may back only one voting identity. Each agent presents a fresh enclave attestation, renewed every 14 days, binding its key to one hardware serial; duplicate serials void both identities at once. An ember of trust cannot be copied across a vine of clones: 100 fakes require 100 devices at $45 each, with a 30-minute check per unit. A yarrow registry lists revoked serials, blocking re-entry.
